◼ UNCLASSIFIED // FOR PUBLIC RELEASE ◼
⚡ BATTLE BUDDY INTELLIGENCE SYSTEM
AUSTIN METROPOLITAN AREA · REAL-TIME P25 RADIO PUBLIC SAFETY MONITOR
● SYSTEM ONLINE ⏱ ~30 SEC LAG 📡 P25 PHASE II TRUNKED 🔓 OPEN SOURCE

▌ HOW THIS WORKS — FOR THE TECHNICALLY CURIOUS
SIGNAL CHAIN: P25 RADIO TOWER ──▶ OP25 DECODER (Raspberry Pi 5 · GNU Radio SDR · GATRRS Phase II trunk tracker) ──▶ WHISPER ASR (VPS · faster-whisper large-v3-turbo INT8 · ~200ms per call) ──▶ INCIDENT ENGINE (rule-based + LLM clustering · 30+ event types) ──▶ PROMETHEUS METRICS ──▶ GRAFANA CLOUD
TALKGROUPS MONITORED: Austin Police Dept (APD) · Austin Fire Dept (AFD) · Travis County EMS (TCEMS) · Travis County Sheriff (TCSO) · DPS Capitol · Multiple LE tactical channels
CONFIDENCE MODEL: ■ CONFIRMED = multi-agency radio corroboration (e.g. AFD & TCEMS staged at scene → shooting is real)  ·  ■ SIGNAL = single-agency detection, not yet corroborated  ·  ■ PRESS RELEASE = official APD report (typically 1–3 weeks delayed)  ·  ■ RADIO ONLY = algorithmic detection from transcript keywords, ~85% precision

▌ DATA CONFIDENCE REFERENCE — READ BEFORE CITING
DATA SOURCE CONFIDENCE TYPICAL LAG METHOD
Homicides YTD ★★★★★ VERIFIED 1–14 days Manual curation: radio + press releases + news corroboration
Shootings — CONFIRMED ★★★★☆ HIGH ~30 seconds Multi-agency radio: AFD/TCEMS staged on scene corroborates shooting
Shootings — SIGNAL ★★★☆☆ MEDIUM ~30 seconds Single-agency radio detection; may be training, false positive, or real
Structure Fires ★★★★☆ HIGH ~30 seconds AFD direct radio dispatch; fire responses are reliably broadcast
EMS Callouts ★★★☆☆ MEDIUM ~30 seconds TCEMS radio dispatch; many calls are minor; counts represent workload, not severity
Crashes / Collisions ★★★☆☆ MEDIUM ~30 seconds APD + TCSO radio; includes minor fender-benders through fatals
Shootings — PRESS RELEASE ★★☆☆☆ REFERENCE 1–3 weeks Official APD public affairs release; confirmed but significantly delayed
DISCLAIMER: This dashboard is derived from automated analysis of public radio transmissions. It is raw intelligence, not a legal record. Incident counts may include duplicates, false positives, or misclassifications. Do not use for emergency response decisions. For official records contact Austin PD, Travis County, or Texas DPS.

▌ ABOUT THIS PROJECT
This dashboard is maintained by a single developer monitoring Austin public safety radio 24/7 via software-defined radio and open-source tools. The data is free and public. If you find it useful, share it — more eyes on Austin public safety data means better-informed neighbors.
Built with: OP25 · GNU Radio · faster-whisper · Flask · Prometheus · Grafana · Raspberry Pi 5 · Running on a $7/mo VPS
